<!-- pr-reviewer: 49c268ba7384a04d2b551435411d5b4b44661f17 -->
**Needs changes before merge.**

Review tier: SAFETY (the PR changes the posted 2D Chamfer toolpath and the gouge verdict of the program sim).

### What looks good

- The generator fix is correct. On a model with a modelled bevel, the tip now rides the wall at the corner depth. A vertical wall gives a gap of 0, so the top loop is ridden and sharp-edged parts post the same G-code as before.
- `corner_z` in `material_source.rs` uses the same formula as `ChamferParams::corner_z` (`top - width * tan(angle)`).
- A top loop with no wall within the width is refused by name, with the location.
- The new tests pin the issue. Both mutations below are caught.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` outside tests. Indexing in `chamfer_ride.rs` is safe (the empty ring case returns before it). The new modules have a provenance line.
- No goldens moved. No UI change. No dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` change.

### Results (merged with main, locally)

Trial merge of the PR head with `upstream/main` (c0c92ee): clean, no conflicts.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **217 steps, 0 failed** (36.5 min). This includes the app, motion and sim lib unit tests, `chamfer_modelled_edge`, `edge_break_gate`, `edge_break_bound`, `golden_cl`, `mill2d_b`, `posting`, `setup_align_chamfer`, `setup_carry_credits`, `solid_law_goldens`, `stock_chamfer_added_part` and `verify`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Mutations (done again by the reviewer, local only, then reverted):

1. Wall filter off (`walled: false` in `plan_ops`): `a_cone_tip_inside_the_part_is_a_gouge_not_edge_break_credit` fails ("a cone tip inside the part posted"). Caught.
2. Generator reverted (`chamfer_ride_loops(&top, &top, ..)`): `a_no_pick_chamfer_on_a_modelled_chamfer_rides_the_wall` and `the_width_moves_the_tip_along_the_bevel_not_only_in_z` fail (tip at x 19, y -9). Caught.

### Requested before merge

1. **`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/wall_anchor.rs:58-64` - the wall test refuses a legal chamfer at a 90-degree inside corner.** At a vertex sample, the two probes go along the normal of the current segment. At an inside corner of the material (90 degrees or sharper), one probe goes into the material and the other probe lands on the top edge of the next segment. `Tops::at` accepts a point on a facet edge, so both probes read the top Z, and the record is dropped. Because a record is all-or-nothing, the full loop then loses its credit.

   Reviewer probe (local test, not pushed): a sharp-edged L-shaped boss (vertical walls, one inside corner at (0, 0)), 10 mm high, stock from the model, one no-pick 2D Chamfer of width 1 with `CM-0600-90`. On this PR the gate gives:
   ```
   gouge: program cuts below the model in 1141 cell(s), worst 0.94 mm at (19.94, -19.81, z 9.06)
   ```
   The gouge is at an outside corner, far from the inside corner: the full bevel lost its credit. With mutation 1 (wall filter off, the same credit as main), the same probe is clean. The same thing will occur on a rectangular pocket with sharp corners, and on any inside corner sharper than 90 degrees. This is a new refusal of a legal program.

   Fix: do not let a vertex probe land on, or past, an adjacent segment. For example, probe along the corner bisector at a vertex, or take the samples only inside each segment, or ignore a probe point that is within `WALL_PROBE` of another segment of the same edge. Add a test for an inside corner (an L-shaped boss and a rectangular pocket) that must stay clean.

2. **`docs/decisions/2435-chamfer-modelled-edge.md:21-23, 54-58` - the decision record does not agree with the code.** It says the probe is "1.5 lattice cells" off the edge, in `sim::stock_sim::edge_break`. The code uses a facet-top probe of `WALL_PROBE = 0.05` mm in `sim::stock_sim::wall_anchor`. The "Cost to change later" paragraph is also about the 1.5-cell probe. Change the record so that it agrees with the code (and with the PR body, which is correct).

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/tests/chamfer_modelled_edge.rs:10`: the gate map names `edge_break::on_walls`. The function is in `wall_anchor`. The gate still selects the suite (by module `sim::stock_sim`), but the name is not correct.
- A record is dropped as a whole when one sample fails. This is on the strict side, which is safe, but it makes a local problem (item 1) a gouge on the full loop. Per-span credit can be a follow-up.
- `stock_sim.rs` is 471 lines (it was over 400 before this PR; it is now 12 lines shorter).
- The PR is still a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b521da7ef94bb0907c2050b0e832109db5cd1f22 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is the independent safety-floor review of the head. The author's own marker at 49c268ba is not counted (self-review).

What looks good:
- crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer_ride.rs picks the wall the cone tip rides. A vertical wall rides the top loop unchanged, so sharp-edged parts post exactly as before. A wall farther than the width refuses by name with the X, Y and Z of the edge. The matcher is one-way and documented.
- crates/sim/src/stock_sim/wall_anchor.rs credits the edge break only where the tip stands on a wall. Records that fail the test are dropped, so the simulation judges that column against the model as it is. That direction is stricter, never looser. Non-finite inputs return false, not a pass.
- `a_cone_tip_inside_the_part_is_a_gouge_not_edge_break_credit` pins the safety property by name. No golden file changes. No unwrap, expect or panic outside tests on the new paths.

Results, built locally on the trial merge with main 983f527bd (clean):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib | 427 passed, 10 ignored |
| cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib | 187 passed |
| cargo test -p camcraft-app --test chamfer_modelled_edge | 5 passed |
| cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib | 364 passed, 1 ignored |
| cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -D warnings | pass |

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking):
- The 400-line rule: crates/app/src/operation/material_source.rs is now 257 lines - fine. docs/decisions entry is present.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app` fails at main's own heights.rs:128 (filed as #2479); nothing from this PR fails clippy.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
